history.content: i dont even know why im opening this. had a thing happen today and i cant shake it
Something happened today, and it is still hanging around. You do not have to know why you opened this to say a little more.
not really scared. more like. ugh. i got passed over for the promotion. they gave it to someone i trained
I had that wrong, let me step back. That sounds more like a hurt or angry kind of ugh, maybe both, and I won’t force a label on it yet.
i guess. but its not really about them. its like everyone in that office now knows i wasnt good enough. the one they kept around to do the grunt work
That lands as a sharper kind of hurt, with shame moving close behind it. Was the hard part the promotion itself, or what it seemed to say about you there?
the second one. i dont even care about the title that much. its that i sat there smiling congratulating her and the whole time thinking what is wrong with me. why am i the one who never gets picked
That sounds like the sting is in being the one who was not picked, while having to keep smiling through it. What was happening in you when you thought, "what is wrong with me"?
honestly it wasnt even new. it was like oh. there it is again. that feeling ive had since i was a kid. like im fundamentally missing something everyone else has. i just got really good at hiding it
That feels older than today, like this loss just lit up something familiar and long-practised. We can stay with that, or leave it here if you want.

can stay a bit. the worst part is i think theyre right not to pick me. like maybe i actually am just the help. i do good work but theres something about me people dont. trust to lead? i dont know. and i cant tell if thats true or if ive just told myself that so long it feels true

That sounds tangled between doubt and self-protection, and I don’t want to make either one too neat. Would you like to stay with the part that feels most true right now, or leave it sitting there for a bit?
yeah. inadequate. thats the word i was dancing around. it just feels embarrassing to even type. like im 38 and still that kid who feels like a fraud at everything. nobody knows that part of me
That feels exposed in a very plain way, like the word itself costs something to say. I’m learning this has embarrassment and hiding in it, not just inadequacy.
yeah. the hiding is most of it honestly. ive spent so much energy making sure no one sees it that getting passed over felt like the mask slipped
That makes sense, the passing over didn’t just miss you, it made the hiding itself feel visible. It sounds like the hard part is not only not being chosen, but being seen through.
yeah. being seen through. thats it exactly. ok. i dont totally know what to do with that but it helps to have said it out loud somewhere. thanks. gonna go sit with it
I’m glad you said it here, and I’ll leave it with you for now.
